0a68ae08fec4: Mark an alignment done · translationCore 4 Help
713d1218f9a9: When a verse is aligned, mark it valid. It counts toward the verses-aligned progress. You can also clear every placed word on the verse back to the word bank.
73920c43d088: It means "this verse's alignment is done", even if some words stay in the word bank.
b0a4929a4563: Finish linking the words of a verse, and confirm or reject any suggestions.
33108dcfb335: Scroll to the bottom of the verse and click ✓ Mark valid.
9ed01acb5a8c: Go to the next verse with the list on the left or with Next →. Marking a verse doesn't move you on.
fc9e63c512d4: Clear the alignments of a verse
6dc5417eba84: On the same footer row, click Clear alignments.
1253bfd93fb0: Confirm in the dialog, for example Clear the alignments of Titus 1:1? It tells you how many placed words go back to the word bank, and that every card keeps its original words.
f7341b652e2a: After you clear, placed words return to the word bank as separate cards, and Clear alignments greys out until you place words again.
96a2f18d2c9b: The count at the top of the list ("0 of 9 verses aligned") goes up for each verse you mark.
1c635dc349f2: If you edit the verse later, the mark is taken back and the verse needs another look. See Editing a verse you already checked or aligned.
711170ac5cca: Upgrading the Greek or Hebrew text also takes the marks back. See Update scripture texts.
f098152b82de: The Align footer row: ← Previous, ✓ Mark valid, Next →, and Clear alignments.
